clauses.text: This circular amends ___ chapter(s) of the Listing Rules.
The record-keeping period is extended to ___.

falseOutputs: Brief rejected — check the circular again.

hints: The circular card (HKEX/RC-2026-017) has all four answers.
Look for: chapters amended, effective date, record-keeping period, and escalation window.
Answers: 3 chapters, 12 May, 5 years, 2 business days.

puzzles.description:
Map each rule change to the responsible team.

Business: disclosures & reporting
Operations: records & document management
Compliance: monitoring & escalation
Technology: systems & integrations

falseOutputs: Wrong assignment. Think about who owns what.

hints: Each change belongs to one team. Who handles disclosures? Who handles systems?
Disclosure → Business. Systems → Technology. Records → Operations. Monitoring → Compliance.
